## Why it happens

A script in the node has an error, an external call (REST, MQTT, e-mail) failed, or the message lacks a field the node needs.

## Fix it

1. Open the rule chain, turn on debug mode on the node, and send a message.
2. Open the node's **Events** to see the incoming message and the error.
3. Fix the script or configuration. Connect the node's **Failure** output to a node that logs or alarms, so failures are not silent.
4. Switch debug mode off when done.

## Check that it worked

New messages leave the node on **Success**.
